name: Describe NGO feedback codebook v1
notes: Generic codebook for humanitarian needs and feedback surveys. Copy and edit per client: rename themes, merge or split them, keep codes short and stable.

themes.description: Food baskets, meals, flour, baby formula, hunger, prices of food.
Asking for cash or vouchers, value of cash transfers, debts, inability to pay for basics.
Tents, damaged homes, rent, overcrowding, blankets, mattresses, winterisation of the shelter.
Drinking water, water trucks, toilets, sewage, hygiene kits, soap, menstrual products.
Medicines, chronic illness, clinics, disability needs, pregnancy care, injuries.
Schools, learning spaces, school supplies, children missing education.
Jobs, income, small business support, vocational training, lost livelihoods.
Power, solar panels, gas for cooking, firewood, charging phones, heating fuel.
Safety, violence, child protection, harassment, risks for women and girls, documents, missing persons.
Stress, fear, children's trauma, need for psychosocial activities or counselling.
Queues, crowding, waiting time, distance to the distribution point, registration lists, fairness and who gets selected.
Not knowing dates or criteria, unanswered hotline, no SMS, wanting to be informed or consulted, complaint channels.
How staff or volunteers treat people: respect, rudeness, favouritism, or praise for staff.
Aid not enough, not suitable, expired or poor quality items, wrong sizes, not matching family size.
Thanks, satisfaction, saying the help made a difference.
Clear content that fits no theme above. Use only when nothing else fits.

followup_rule: Set needs_followup to true if the answer reports abuse, exploitation, being asked for money or favours in exchange for aid, a threat to someone's safety, a medical emergency, or a child at risk. These go to a trained staff member, never only to a dashboard.
